name: logbook
description: Logbook: a personal training, habits and journal app. PWA + API.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @logbook/shared build && pnpm --filter @logbook/web build && pnpm --filter @logbook/api build
scripts.ios: pnpm --filter @logbook/shared build && VITE_FEATURE_STRAVA=1 pnpm --filter @logbook/web build:ios && (cd apps/web && npx cap sync ios) && node scripts/ios-dev-plist.mjs && (cd apps/web && npx cap open ios)
